chapters.title: The Night He Named Someone Else
chapters.summary: Lina watches Adrian publicly align himself with Selene in the room she helped him reach.
chapters.text: At the launch party, Adrian thanks Selene for believing in him while Lina stands three steps away, still holding the tablet that saved his presentation. The investors smile at Selene as if devotion can be inherited. Lina notices that Adrian does not look at her when he says, in a voice meant for the room, that some people simply know how to belong. Later, alone on the balcony, he asks Lina to stay close because he cannot survive these rooms without her calm. She lets the silence between them lengthen until it hurts him more than an answer.
